reporting_transform: multiply the complete absolute-anomaly exposure contrast and its interval endpoints by -1, reversing endpoint order
positive_direction: greater relative resistance; absolute phenological deviation is smaller or increases less under higher exposure
negative_direction: loss of resistance; absolute phenological deviation is larger under higher exposure

primary_estimand.name: occurrence-based resistance
primary_estimand.population: all eligible event and non-event years

companion_outcome.name: signed cross-fitted anomaly
companion_outcome.role: direction of timing shift only; not the resistance measure

contrast_hierarchy: UA-minus-PA resistance at fixed moderator values
moderator_rule: freeze no more than three primary axes from predictor-only measurement, support and collinearity audits
prohibited_equivalences: resistance is not resilience or recovery
absolute anomaly is not physiological tolerance
landscape association is not causal effect of urbanization or protection
land-cover moderation is not proof of a canopy or biodiversity mechanism
